about_the_game:
Whacked! is an action-packed top-down 2D/3D online PvP shooter. You and up to three friends can battle it out, round by round, to see who deserves a spot beside the big boss.

Customization

Customizing your gangster plays a huge factor when trying to impress your superiors. Choose an animal of your liking, alter the color and pattern of your suit, and get ready for chaos.

Gameplay

Each round, players fight on a new map that is chosen at random. All maps contain different weapon spawns, destructible elements, and unique layouts. The boss will reward his henchmen periodically to remind them who's in charge.

Will you be the last one standing?

content_descriptors.notes: This game features cartoon-style combat with stylized blood effects. The violence is not graphic or realistic, and there are no depictions of gore, sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. While the tone is lighthearted, the presence of animated blood may not be suitable for very young players. All violence is presented in a lighthearted, animated style.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 M380
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable internet connection required for multiplayer features. Performance may vary depending on system configuration.

short_description: The big boss is looking for a new right-hand henchman, so it’s your time to shine! Choose a gangster, put on your most stylish suit, and WHACK your friends in this fast-paced, action-packed, top-down PvP shooter! Dive and shoot your way through destructible maps while trying to not get WHACKED!
